title: Invite gives one link that signs a person in once from any device, and the master stays confined
description: Against a real control plane and a temporary Postgres, with the host loop's tailscale turning Funnel on for the install's own port alone: Invite returns exactly one link on the Funnel address; opening it as a public request with no Tailscale login signs the person in, and a second open is refused; links last the days the owner picked; a teammate's session is short and renews with use; revoking a maintainer closes their Master page at once; typed lines are listed with who and when. Under real bubblewrap, a command typed into the master session cannot read the operator's token or write the checkout or home outside .graphyard.

steps.name: One-link invite, Funnel, revoke, typed list and master confinement
